## R packages

::: {.grid .package-grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .package-card}
### blockTools

Designing, conducting, and analyzing randomized experiments — including blocking on continuous covariates, assignment, and interference diagnostics.

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=blockTools){.pkg-link} · [Details](software/blocktools.qmd){.pkg-link}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .package-card}
### whatifbandit

Reanalyzing randomized experiments as if they had been conducted as multi-arm bandits (MABs).

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=whatifbandit){.pkg-link} · [GitHub](https://github.com/Noch05/whatifbandit){.pkg-link}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .package-card}
### muRL

Mailmerge in R and LaTeX — read spreadsheets of addresses, generate customizable letters, map ZIP codes, and scrape APSA eJobs HTML.

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=muRL){.pkg-link} · [Details](software/murl.qmd){.pkg-link}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .package-card}
### eiPack

Ecological inference and higher-dimension data management. With Olivia Lau and Mike Kellermann.

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=eiPack){.pkg-link}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .package-card}
### oesr

Statistical analysis and treatment-effect reporting in the style of the US Office of Evaluation Sciences. Works with model objects from `lm()` and `estimatr::lm_robust()`.

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=oesr){.pkg-link} · [OES standards](https://oes.gsa.gov/assets/files/reporting-statistical-results.pdf){.pkg-link}
:::

:::
